import json,pathlib,datetime,sys
base=pathlib.Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/output/submissions/2026-11-05-remaining')
r=json.loads(sys.argv[2]); draft=json.loads(sys.argv[3])
p=base/'submission-manifest.json'; m=json.loads(p.read_text())
entry=next(x for x in m['papers'] if x['id']==sys.argv[1])
assert any(l['href']==entry['url'] for l in r['links'])
ids=[i['id'] for i in r['ids'] if i['tag']=='SECTION' and i['id'].startswith('s')]
assert ids
entry['solution_url']=r['url'].split('#')[0]+'#'+ids[-1]
entry['solution_status']='posted_and_link_verified'
entry['solution_posted_at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
(base/entry['id']/'solution-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'observed':r,'submitted':draft},indent=2)+'\n')
p.write_text(json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n')
print(entry['solution_url'])
